name: AgentFEM MCP
description: Create, validate and run inspectable finite-element projects, then retrieve numerical evidence through seven typed local tools. Requires Python 3.11+ and a separately installed compatible AgentFEM scientific runtime; the adapter alone does not provide the solver. No embedded LLM or hosted compute service.

AGENTFEM_MCP_ROOTS.description: Approved local project directories separated by the platform path separator. Configure an explicit project directory; if omitted, access is restricted to the server working directory.

AGENTFEM_COMMAND.description: Absolute path to the separately installed agentfem executable when automatic runtime discovery is not suitable. Must be accessible in the server environment.
